example_cn: 务实的做法是把阴性结果发表出来。
root_note: prag (deed) → 从做事出发 → 务实

definition_en: dependent on chance; not securely held
example_en: Funding for the group has been precarious for years.
example_cn: 这个组的经费多年来一直不稳定。
root_note: prec (prayer) → 只能靠祈求 → 不稳

definition_en: ordinary and unimaginative
example_en: The prosaic explanation turned out to be the right one.
example_cn: 那个平淡无奇的解释最后被证明是对的。
root_note: 源自 prose「散文」→ 不像诗 → 平淡

translation_cn: [adj] 沉默寡言的；不愿多说的
definition_en: unwilling to speak freely about something
example_en: He was reticent about the funding source and that was itself informative.
example_cn: 他对资金来源避而不谈，这本身就说明问题。
root_note: re (back) + tic (be silent) → 把话收回 → 沉默

definition_en: to examine closely and critically
example_en: Every figure is scrutinized once the paper is famous.
example_cn: 论文一出名，每张图都会被仔细审视。
root_note: scrut (search) → 细查 → 审视

definition_en: to provide evidence for a claim
example_en: None of the three claims was substantiated.
example_cn: 三个说法没有一个得到证实。
root_note: substance → 给说法加上实质 → 证实

definition_en: very weak or slight; easily broken
example_en: The link between the two findings is tenuous at best.
example_cn: 这两项发现之间的联系至多是牵强的。
root_note: ten (thin) → 细 → 脆弱

definition_en: found everywhere
example_en: The assumption is so ubiquitous that nobody states it.
example_cn: 这个假设无处不在，以至于没人再明说。
root_note: ubi (where) → 到处都是 → 无处不在

definition_en: to show that someone was right after all
example_en: Ten years later the replication vindicated her.
example_cn: 十年后的重复实验证明她是对的。
root_note: vin (force) + dic (say) → 有力地说清 → 正名

definition_en: living in or relating to trees
example_en: Arboreal animals rarely descend to the forest floor.
example_cn: 树栖动物很少下到林地地面。
root_note: arbor (tree) → 与树有关 → 树栖的

definition_en: of an animal that hunts and eats other animals
example_en: A predator this size needs a large territory.
example_cn: 这种体型的捕食者需要很大的领地。
root_note: praed (prey) → 捕猎 → 捕食性的

definition_en: a close relationship between two organisms that benefits both
example_en: The symbiosis between the fungus and the plant took decades to describe.
example_cn: 真菌与植物之间的共生关系用了几十年才描述清楚。
root_note: sym (together) + bio (life) → 一起生活 → 共生

definition_en: relating to an earthquake or to vibrations in the ground
example_en: Seismic records showed the earthquake began offshore.
example_cn: 地震记录显示这次地震始于近海。
root_note: 源自希腊语 seismos「震动」→ 地震的

definition_en: relating to the sky or to a star or planet
example_en: Early celestial maps put the Earth at the centre.
example_cn: 早期的天体图把地球放在中心。
root_note: cael (heaven) → 天上的 → 天体的

definition_en: the process of taking legal action in court
example_en: Years of litigation settled nothing that a phone call could not.
example_cn: 多年的诉讼没能解决一个电话就能解决的事。
root_note: lit (dispute) + ag (drive) → 把争端推进法庭 → 诉讼

definition_en: relating to government financial matters and revenue
example_en: The fiscal case for the programme was never made public.
example_cn: 这个项目的财政论证从未公开。
root_note: fisc (treasury) → 国库 → 财政的

definition_en: relating to war, the military, or soldiers
example_en: Martial imagery runs through the whole speech.
example_cn: 整篇演讲都贯穿着军事意象。
root_note: 源自罗马战神 Mars → 军事的

definition_en: a fixed form of public religious worship
example_en: The liturgy has changed less than the building around it.
example_cn: 礼拜仪式的变化比它所在的建筑还要小。
root_note: 源自希腊语 leitourgia「公共服务」→ 礼拜仪式

definition_en: the everyday spoken language of a place, as opposed to formal literary usage
example_en: Writing in the vernacular was once a literary scandal.
example_cn: 用方言写作曾经是文学界的丑闻。
root_note: verna (native slave) → 本地人说的话 → 方言

definition_en: a microorganism that causes disease
example_en: Identifying the pathogen took longer than treating the patient.
example_cn: 确定病原体花的时间比治疗病人还长。
root_note: path (suffering) + gen (produce) → 引起病痛 → 病原体

definition_en: the mental processes of perception, reasoning and memory
example_en: Sleep loss degrades cognition long before people notice it.
example_cn: 睡眠不足在人们察觉之前就已经损害认知了。
root_note: co (together) + gn (know) → 知道 → 认知
